entity: armarium (Eaprime1/armarium, private), created by eaprime1; kit pushed by Claude (Sonnet 5.5) for Navigo Claude
event: The private origin vault Armarium is born: an empty repo created by the Shepherd, then the custos kit pushed to its main
stamp_note: 202610172005 is the stamp (UTC) of the kit push, when the first custos file entered the repo. The Shepherd created the repo shortly before; its exact creation time was not recorded. Filed 202610172020.

witness.initial_commit: 66ec6ffa (GitHub, one-line README written by the Shepherd)
files: README.md (the Shepherd's line first, then the layout and rules from the kit)

left_in_place: The kit stays in custos under atelier/heritage-pipeline/ as the record of what was pushed. No origin has been placed in the Armarium yet.
open_questions: Branch protection cannot be enforced: GitHub does not apply it to a private repo outside a Team or Enterprise account. Nothing blocks a force-push or deletion on main. A detection workflow (fail a push that changes or deletes anything under origins/) is not built.
The hash rule (exact bytes, hash beside the file, sha256sum -c) is a recommendation used by the kit. The Shepherd said they were unsure and asked for the repo; it has not been explicitly ratified.
Genizah (retired scrolls kept readable inside the Armarium) is a proposal in ARMARIUM.md section 6, not built.
The repo description and the one-line README opener were a first working note; the README opener has since been rewritten (armarium f31d272), and the GitHub About field is the Shepherd's to set.
Suit proposed as ♦️ (active development), pending the Deck Master and world/suit-and-plank.md.
notes: Registry row and this carrier are Deck Master paths. Proposed by the navigo for review, not self-approved.
